info.name: Super Karigar — Employer App API (v1)
info.description:
Token-based (Sanctum) JSON API for the Super Karigar employer mobile app.

Quick start:
1. Set the `base_url` collection variable (default http://localhost:8000).
2. Run **Auth → Send OTP**, then check storage/logs for the dev OTP.
3. Run **Auth → Verify OTP (employer)** — it auto-saves the returned token into `token`, so every other request is authenticated.
4. **Jobs → Create job** auto-saves the new `job_id`; **Team → Add member** auto-saves `member_id`.

All `employer/*` routes require the employer role and are scoped to the employer account (owner + team).

Full reference: docs/employer-app-api.md

request.description: Send/resend a 4-digit OTP. In dev (no MSG91 keys) the code is written to storage/logs.
Verify OTP → issue token (auto-registers an employer + empty profile on first login). The test script stores the token. `needs_registration: true` → route into the business setup wizard.
Dropdowns/chips: states, skills, job_categories, wage_types, shifts, perks, contact_modes, industries, company_sizes, app_languages.
Stats + active jobs + recent applicants in one call.

request.description: Post a job (or `status: draft`). Notifies matching workers when active. Set `status` to draft to Save-draft.

AI drafts for the Post Job description box. `title` is required (3-150 chars); `category`, `city`, `state` and `skills[]` are optional and only sharpen the draft. Returns `{ "suggestions": [...] }` - normally two, but exactly one template-built draft when no AI key is configured, so render whatever length comes back. Throttled to 20/min; the same wording is cached for a day.
Paginated + a `counts` block for the segmented tabs.

Everyone shortlisted across all of the employer's jobs - the app's standalone Shortlisted screen. Paginated 20/page, most recently shortlisted first, each row carrying its `job`. The per-job tab is the applicants list with `stage=shortlisted`.
`accepted` = hire, `rejected` = reject. Notifies the worker (in-app + email).
Reveals the worker's phone/email, consuming one plan unlock. 422 if the limit is reached.
Application must be accepted (hired). One review per worker+job.

Streams the applicant's resume PDF, token-authenticated - send the same Bearer header as every other call, so the app can preview or save the file in place. This is the URL returned as `ApplicantResource.resume.download_url`. 403 when the application is not on one of your jobs; 404 when the worker has no resume.

item.name: AI Screening Calls
item.description: The platform rings the applicant, asks whether they are still interested and collects an interview time to offer. The agent never books anything - the employer confirms the slot.

request.description: Calls placed for this applicant, newest first, plus `can_call` / `blocked_because`. Drive the "Call & schedule" button off `can_call`; when false show `blocked_because` as the disabled reason (`provider_not_configured`, `no_caller_id`, `application_closed`, `interview_already_scheduled`, `no_phone_number`, `worker_opted_out`, `call_in_progress`, `already_screened`). Pass `?with_transcript=1` on the detail screen to include transcripts.

Queues the call. No body. 202 with `calling_at` - calls only go out inside the permitted daytime window, so one queued at night is held until morning; compare `calling_at` to now to choose between "Calling now..." and "Queued for ...". 422 with a `code` from the blocker list when the applicant cannot be called. The result arrives by push - re-fetch the list, there is no websocket.

Books the time the worker offered and notifies them. Send an empty body to accept the proposed slot as-is; send `interview_at` (future) only to move it, and `mode` from the interview modes in GET /reference. 422 `{ "code": "no_proposed_slot" }` when the call produced no time to confirm.
Typesense-powered. Rows beyond the plan quota come back locked (phone null).
`worker_id` is a worker PROFILE id. Contact shown only if unlocked via an application.
multipart/form-data. Docs jpg/png/pdf ≤5 MB (optional on re-submit).
Call after login and whenever FCM rotates the token. platform: android | ios | web.
Stops pushes to this device.
Reviews workers left for this employer, with a rating summary.
Roles: manager | recruiter. The member logs in with their own mobile OTP.

The tax invoice as data, so the app lays it out natively instead of opening the session-authenticated web page. Ids come from `invoices[].id` on the plans call. 403 for another account's invoice, 404 before the subscription is paid. Team members read the owner's invoices.

item.name: Legal & Support (public)
item.description: Terms & Privacy and Help & Support. No token needed - the OTP screen links to the legal documents before an account exists, and someone who cannot sign in still needs help.

request.description: Both documents without their bodies, for the settings row. `web_url` is the same text as a web page for an "open in browser" link - it is null for the terms (no web page yet), so handle null. `updated_label` is pre-formatted; `updated_at` is for comparing.

The full document as sections of blocks. Exactly three block types: `paragraph` and `heading` carry `text`, `list` carries `items`. `heading` is a sub-heading inside a section - render it smaller than the section title and keep it out of the contents rail (build that from sections[].title / sections[].id). The identity-document section disappears when an admin switches verification off, so build the screen from what you get.
Same shape as the privacy policy. Any document key other than `terms` or `privacy` returns 404.

FAQs plus the ways to reach a person. A channel that is not configured is left out entirely - do not render a row for a missing key. `whatsapp` is digits with country code and no "+", so the app builds its own wa.me link. Pass `audience` (worker|employer) to get your app's entries plus the shared ones; omit it for all. Anything else returns 422. `id` is stable, so a single answer can be deep-linked.
